source.title: Device security principles for manufacturers: Constrain the use of all device interfaces
source.applicability: Provides authoritative guidelines for manufacturers on securing device interfaces, including explicit requirements for disabling unnecessary services, mitigating interface misuse, and managing physical and logical interfaces to prevent unauthorized access and exfiltration

passages.text: It shall be made clear which services are running over both logical and external physical interfaces, and whether the user or organisation can disable those services
The manufacturer shall state which mitigations against interface misuse are available

A device is left unattended and an attacker takes the opportunity to physically attack the device to gain access. The device is using an IOMMU which prevents an unsophisticated actor from successfully conducting a Direct Memory Access attack
